summary: Verified tool-popover edge-flush behavior in GalaxyNotes handwriting screen on phone viewport (390x844). Test 1 (left toolbar, top-aligned pen) PASSES cleanly. Tests 2, 3, 4 could NOT be validated as specified because of TWO factors — one is a review-spec mismatch (tool-ruler is a toggle button and does NOT open the tool-options popover, so it cannot be used as the flip anchor), and one is a REAL layout/positioning issue: on the top toolbar the row is >390px wide and family-pen actually renders at x≈167 (near center-left, not near-left). The right-side flip branch anchors card.right to tool.right — when tool.right<CARD_W (260), the popover overflows the LEFT edge of the screen (card.x=-57 measured). A similar horizontal-scroll problem hides family-eraser (rightmost family) off-screen at x=443. Added testID="tool-opts-card" on the popover Pressable so bboxes can be measured reliably. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView not seen. No React Native red screen. No backend testing (frontend-only as requested).

ui_bugs.issue: When popover flips right (roomRight < CARD_W), positionStyle.right is set to winW - toolRight. If toolRight < CARD_W, the popover overflows the LEFT edge. Measured on 390x844 after switching toolbar to TOP and double-tapping family-pen (pen bbox x=167.83, width=44 → tap.x=189.83, toolRight=203.83, roomRight=178.17 < 260 → FLIP; positionStyle.right = 186.17 → card.x = 390 - 186.17 - 260 = -56.17). Popover extends off-screen to the left; violates `card.x ≥ 8`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx:1728-1743 (top and bottom branches).

Horizontal toolbar (top/bottom) is wider than a 390px phone viewport (~10 tools × 44 = 440+ px). Rightmost family (family-eraser) renders at x=443 and tool-ruler at x=489 — both off-screen without scrolling. Any popover-flip test that requires tapping a tool near the RIGHT edge is unreachable without programmatic scroll. Reference: /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx:1289-1315 (family + ruler layout inside horizontal ScrollView).

integration_issues.issue: Review request steps 3 and 5 say 'Tap tool-ruler ... it again to open the popover' and use it as the flip anchor. In the current code (/app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx:1302-1315) tool-ruler is a modifier toggle: its onPress only toggles rulerEnabled, it never sets toolOptAnchor / setShowToolOpts(true). Consequently tests 2 and 4 (as written) can never trigger the popover from tool-ruler. Substituted with the bottom-most / right-most FAMILY button (family-eraser) as anchor.

The flip condition winH - insets.bottom - 8 - toolTop < 360 does not trigger on 390x844 for family-eraser (bottom-most family). Its tap center is y≈448.5, giving roomBelow ≈ 403.5 (>= 360). The popover therefore stays in TOP-aligned mode (measured card_top=434 vs anchor_top=431, |Δ|=3). This is the correct default behavior for this viewport — the FLIP path is not exercised. Note: even for the true `tool-ruler` position (y=470), roomBelow ≈ 362 which is still >= 360, so FLIP is never reachable with default insets on this viewport. Consider lowering the flip threshold or shortening the popover before flipping.

action_items: Fix flip-right / flip-bottom overflow: when the flip branch places card off-screen (card.x < 8 or card.y < 8), clamp positionStyle.left/top instead of using `right`/`bottom` alone. E.g. after computing right, verify winW - right - CARD_W >= 8 else fall back to left = max(8, winW - CARD_W - 8) or center the card.

Decide UX for tool-ruler popover: either (a) update the review-spec so tests use a family button as anchor, or (b) give tool-ruler the same handleFamilyTap-style behavior so a second tap opens a small Ruler settings popover with unit/zoom controls.

Handle horizontal toolbar overflow on narrow phone viewports: either enable inline scroll indicator, shrink button spacing, or wrap into two rows so all families/ruler are reachable without swiping (currently family-eraser and tool-ruler are off-screen at x=443/489 on 390x844).

Lower the flip threshold from 360 or dynamically use the actual measured popover height, so the flip-bottom branch actually engages when needed (currently roomBelow≈403 for the bottommost family on 390x844 keeps it in top-aligned mode).
critical_code_review_comments: The popover positioning block (/app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx:1691-1749) still hard-codes 360 as a proxy for popover height. Comment says 'We do not use a fixed APPROX_H anymore' but the 360 constant on line 1707/1718 serves the same purpose. Consider measuring the card via onLayout and using that measurement.

positionStyle.right / positionStyle.bottom values are not sanity-checked against CARD_W / winW. For a right-anchored card, adding a safety net `winW - right - CARD_W >= 8` would prevent left-edge overflow seen in test 3.

tool-ruler onPress toggles rulerEnabled without ever calling setShowToolOpts. If the intent (per review) is to expose ruler settings via re-tap, wire it through handleFamilyTap-like logic or an inline sub-menu.
File is 3,347 lines long — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the popover, toolbar, and menu blocks into sub-components.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of test 3 failure: The flip-right branch in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx:1728-1743 computes `positionStyle.right = Math.max(8, winW - toolRight)` in isolation. It aligns card_right with tool_right without checking whether the resulting card_left = winW - right - CARD_W is >= 8. When the tool's right edge is less than CARD_W (i.e., the tool is closer to the left edge than the popover width), the popover extends past the left edge of the screen. Reproduction: switch toolbar to TOP → double-tap family-pen on 390x844. Popover card.x = -57 (should be >= 8). Mitigation options: (1) after computing `right`, if winW - right - CARD_W < 8 then instead do `positionStyle.left = 8` (accept the card being wider than the natural flush position) or center it; (2) never trigger flip-right when there isn't enough room on either side — instead pin CARD_W to fit; (3) shrink CARD_W dynamically on narrow viewports.
